pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Exactly TWO stages of peeling the SAME orange arranged left to right: LEFT one whole intact orange, RIGHT peeled orange segments with the orange peel laid beside them. A simple gray rightward arrow BETWEEN the two stages shows chronological progression. A red oval encloses ONLY the LEFT (FIRST) stage, and one red downward arrow points to that stage. Meaning BEFORE, the earlier stage. No other objects, no text or symbols beyond the nonverbal arrows and oval. Complete objects, generous white margins. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
